notablePrerequisites: Swift Reconfiguration attached to Synod Artificer.
description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Activate Synod Artificer's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping itself and Chromatic Orrery.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead activate Chromatic Orrery's second ability to draw infinite cards.
